title: Stored Credential
applicability: Visa, MasterCard, Discover and Amex initial credential storage, subsequent MIT recurring/installment/unscheduled and CIT profiles. This is a logical-field oracle, not a complete serialized ATL105 validator.

definitions.storedCredential: An account number or payment token stored by a merchant, agent, payment facilitator or staged digital wallet operator for future cardholder transactions.
excluded: Details stored to finish a single transaction
Details stored for related multiple authorizations such as increments
definitions.cit: The cardholder actively participates, whether at a terminal, online checkout or a subsequent stored-credential transaction.
definitions.mit: A subsequent transaction with previously stored credentials, prior cardholder consent and no active cardholder engagement.
subsequentExamples: A separate purchase using the same card at the same merchant
Recurring payment associated with the original transaction
Installment associated with the original transaction
definitions.limitation: Section 10.13.2.4.2 expressly states the use cases are not exhaustive.

sourceNotes: When no amount is due on initial storage, a zero-dollar Account Verification with Table 032/08 I can be sent; this is permission, not a universal mandate.
Initial amount-due recurring/installment uses Table 013 R/I and original POS entry mode; unscheduled initial storage does not require R/I.
Table 005 is a three-character field: two-character PAN mode plus PIN capability. Appendix Z's mode 10 is not a complete two-character Table 005 payload.

Subsequent MIT recurring/installment must not include CVV2; CIT recurring/installment initial profiles must not include CVV2. Subsequent CIT permits optional CVV2. No universal CVV2 prohibition is invented for MIT unscheduled or ordinary initial storage.
Discover original approved amount must be retained for all subsequent MIT; Table 045 has up to 12 digits with two assumed decimals.
Discover India-issued MIT recurring/unscheduled strictly above USD 52 refers to Table 056 tags 01-08; Appendix I describes 01/02/05 as first-payment-only, so subsequent requiredness is review-gated.

Discover MIT installment refers to Table 056 tags 01/08, Table 049/13 S/T/V, provider*retailer name, underlying retailer city/state/country and SIC. Tag 01's first-payment-only conflict remains review-gated.

Visa/Amex response Table 028 maps to request Table 044. Appendix Z says original reference reuse, but Appendix I Table 044 illustrates rotating references; mismatches are reviewed, not silently accepted or automatically failed.
Discover response Table 012 maps to subsequent request Table 015. Credential/reference association and actual durable storage need external evidence.
MasterCard Table 056/09 defines CIT C101/C102/C103/C104 and MIT M101/M102/M103/M104 for adhoc/unscheduled, standing order, subscription and installment respectively.
Visa India recurring refers broadly to Table 056 tags 01-13, but Appendix I requires the Visa-specific tags 01/02/03/05/06/12/13, not Discover-only tags 04/07/08 or MasterCard-only tag 09.

Visa India Table 056/12 actions are 1 registration, 2 subsequent, 3 modification and 4 cancellation. Subsequent amounts <=15000 INR are non-ecommerce without CAVV; amounts >15000 INR require ecommerce, Terminal Type 25 and CAVV. Modification/cancellation require authentication; cancellation is zero-dollar Account Verification.

Visa India registration reference 056/13 stays fixed; recurring parameters 01/02/03/05/06 follow registration or latest modification. Successful original registration, authentication and authorization are prerequisites for subsequent recurring.

Issuer-country identification, exchange-rate equivalence, consent, retailer provenance, authorization success, cryptographic validity and RBI mandate updates are external inputs; values are checked under the 2026-3 source only. Appendix I encourages subscription to the Global BIN File for accurate India-issued-account identification.

Appendix I Table 032/08 additionally applies initial/subsequent indicators to Authorization, Completion, Cancellation and Reversal COF messages; lifecycle serialization beyond the selected Appendix Z financial profiles is not certified.

businessRequirements.title: Classify supported brands and mutually consistent declared flow/purpose without extending the non-exhaustive use cases.
Initial storage sends 032/08 I and original entry mode; amount-due recurring/installment sends R/I; zero-dollar verification is optional when no amount is due.
MIT recurring sends Table 013 R, 032/08 C, 049/02 M and Table 005 PAN mode 10.
MIT installment sends Table 013 I, 032/08 C, 049/02 M and Table 005 PAN mode 10.
MIT unscheduled omits R/I and sends 032/08 C, 049/02 M and Table 005 PAN mode 10.
CIT recurring/installment initial profiles send R/I, 032/08 I, 049/02 C and original Table 005 entry mode.
Subsequent CIT sends 032/08 C, 049/02 C and Table 005 PAN mode 10; CVV2 is optional.
CVV2 Table 004 is absent in the explicitly prohibited MIT recurring/installment and initial CIT recurring/installment profiles; no unlisted prohibition is inferred.
Store Visa/Amex response 028 or Discover response 012 and reuse request 044 or 015 on subsequent MIT; original-versus-rolling Visa/Amex reference conflict is reviewed.
Discover subsequent MIT Table 045 retains original approved amount with up to 12 numeric digits and assumed two decimals.
India-issued Discover recurring/unscheduled MIT strictly above USD 52 refers to Table 056 tags 01-08; first-payment-only conflicts remain reviewed.
Discover MIT installment requires 056/01,056/08, installment type 049/13 and third-party retailer name/location/SIC context; first-payment-only conflict is retained.
Discover unscheduled Delayed Card Sale uses Table 016 D; No Show Charge uses Table 017 N.
MasterCard Table 056/09 carries applicable CIT/MIT category/subcategory for all Appendix Z profiles.
Visa India recurring uses brand-specific Table 056 tags, authentication/amount/action rules and registration/latest-modification carry-forward under supplied evidence.
Validate the logical widths/value sets and brand applicability of the referenced Table 056 tags; no generic wire-length certification.
MIT requires prior consent and no active cardholder engagement; stored-credential provenance and excluded single-transaction/incremental usage require business evidence.

testDataReadinessSummary.note: All 20 fixtures execute a bounded predicate, including explicit REVIEW_REQUIRED outcomes. This does not imply real merchant/network certification. JUnit also tests brand matrices, numeric thresholds, all MasterCard categories and Visa registration/modification/cancellation.

fixtureSemantics: Shallow merge fixtureDefaults with payload to form a complete Scenario; payload maps replace default maps. Synthetic fixtures target expected.businessRequirementId, not an aggregate transaction approval verdict.
testDataStatus: Logical predicates and source-anchored fixtures are executable; external evidence and source conflicts remain explicit.
remaining: Resolve Discover first-payment-only tags versus Appendix Z subsequent-MIT wording.
Resolve original versus rotating Visa/Amex reference selection.
Obtain trustworthy consent, identity, storage, issuer-country, FX equivalence, retailer and registration/authorization evidence; supplied flags do not prove these facts.
Validate complete serialized Table 056 framing, outer ATL105 envelopes and all completion/reversal/cancellation lifecycle messages separately; this oracle accepts logical fields only.
Network/issuer certification, authenticity of CAVV and future RBI threshold changes are outside synthetic validation.
